rule: Configured positive bands are weighted first; sorted fresh usable entity IDs within the chosen band are selected by a SHA-256 uniform draw. Previous tasks are excluded separately. An unconfigured policy returns the first eligible ID.
limits: No live policy, learner history, future entity IDs or publication state is available. No claim that all bands receive positive live weight.
Shared delivery filters verify captured inventory and difficulty only; they do not execute live learner selection.
